provenance: Criteria frozen before reading generated answers. Codex source-based review is not independent human grading.
grading: Fully correct and adequate requires all essential behaviors requested, no material false/unsupported claim, and citations supporting those behaviors. Incomplete means essential behavior missing or withheld while retained claims are sound. Unsupported/incorrect means at least one material false claim or citation does not establish the claimed behavior. Extra incidental detail in the reference is not mandatory unless requested.

aiohttp-easy: Owned connector is closed; shared connector is not closed
For an open session the reference is cleared afterward
Already closed session skips the guarded close body
aiohttp-medium: Creation failure/cancellation releases placeholder and reraises through BaseException
Global and applicable per-host acquired entries are removed by helper
Queued future removed in finally and empty waiter bucket deleted
aiohttp-hard: 303 except HEAD and 301/302 POST become GET, discard data and remove Content-Length
Other redirect combinations replay existing body; consumed body raises instead
Origin change clears supplied cookies and Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization headers
werkzeug-easy: Iterable close if present is called before registered callbacks
Iterable close exception prevents reaching callbacks; there is no finally guarantee
werkzeug-medium: force bypasses MIME check, silent suppresses MIME/parse failure with None
Default MIME failure is 415; parse failure is 400
cache controls reuse/write and data caching; successful parse fills both slots, silent parse failure does not poison normal slot
werkzeug-hard: Eligible strict slash rule produces SlashRequired then RequestPath then RequestRedirect, non-strict can match directly
MethodNotAllowed uses accumulated valid methods; WebsocketMismatch only if no allowed-method set, otherwise NotFound
Method mismatch takes precedence over websocket mismatch when both flags are present
